corrected_content.problem: What is the minimum value of $f(x) =-\cos (x + \frac{π}{4}) + 3$?
corrected_content.worked_solution: As $\cos(x+\pi/4)$ ranges from $-1$ to $1$, its negative also ranges from $-1$ to $1$. Adding $3$ gives the range $[2,4]$. The minimum is $2$.
